rationale.conceptual: The FE homogenization and Halpin-Tsai model are well-documented, non-novel methods, but correctly implementing the RVE with interphase layers, periodic boundary conditions, and extracting transversely isotropic constants requires genuine understanding and careful coding, rating it as a 3 (established but non-trivial).

Orchestrating these with an open-source FE tool constitutes a multi-stage pipeline, though not extremely long or fragile, rating it 3.
